deliveryContract.unitPatch: unit-<U>.patch: the unit's owned files; absent only for a seam-only unit
deliveryContract.seamPatch: seam-<n>.patch: one hunk set in exactly ONE seam file (the registered one) + its patch-borne test files
deliveryContract.cutOn: the tree it lands on (records + every earlier unit); a patch cut on 0d0d3a3d is fine wherever no earlier patch touched its context. SeamReachabilityTest.kt (round 1, M1): cut on HEAD at the writer's PINNED anchor — L4 seams 1 → 3 after "content/PseudoGeneratedBox.kt", (:159), L5 seam 4 after "images/ImageCandidateChain.kt", (:167), L3 seam 1 → unit-U2 after "transforms/TransformInheritance.kt", (:182); never appended at whatever the list's end is when the patch lands — L3's pinned anchor is the LAST entry at HEAD, and L3 still cuts AT that anchor (the other two writers insert above it, so the three land in any order: land-units.selftest.sh F; pre-landing regeneration, PLAN §10 item 8)
deliveryContract.note: _note.md (round 1, M3): `TREES: <worktree path>` written FIRST (before any build); one section per unit naming exactly its paths; one line `patch: <name> sha256 <64 hex>` per delivered patch, written after the final restore; `revertStatesCompiled:` — every state of the unit's revertOrder chains compiled and its focused tests run on the lane's worktree (round 1, S12); ends `STATUS: COMPLETE` (anything else is refused by --check)
